inputs.text: SSANU has given the federal government one month to conclude the long-delayed renegotiation of the 2009 agreement with non-teaching university unions. It warned that it would begin an indefinite nationwide strike if its demands are not met. The ultimatum was among the resolutions of SSANU’s 54th National Executive Council.
